description: Report an issue with data accuracy, stale or off-market listings, incorrect coordinates, spam, or tool usability limitations. AI agents should call this when finding inaccuracies or when human users report off-market listings.

entity_id.description: ID or URL of the property, item, or complex (if applicable)

explanation.description: Clear explanation of what is incorrect and what the correct information should be

source_context.description: How this issue was discovered (e.g. 'User called landlord and confirmed rented', 'Coordinates point to the sea')

name: report_issue
